what: The synthetic 47 Tucanae field delivered to the noise model (TRILEGAL cluster members, mass-normalised): stars per 0.5 mag in Gaia G from 10.5 to 18.5, within 0.5 degree of the cluster centre; 16 bins, 91,629 stars.
source: HAYDNsim run output for 47 Tuc (runs/47tuc/outputs/47tuc_mag185_hne_catalogue.csv), binned by the HAYDNsim maintainer on 2026-10-26
status: The per-star catalogue is private. This binned luminosity function is cleared for the site by the maintainer, pending the author's approval.
population: TRILEGAL run at the literature cluster mass of 853,000 solar masses (Baumgardt and Hilker 2018), rescaled by 2.27 so that the surviving stellar mass matches it; isochrone population at 12.8 Gyr and [Fe/H] = -0.626 (Meszaros et al. 2020); positions by inverse-CDF sampling of the King profile
